source.name: Football Shirt Culture: France 2026/27 Nike Home Kit
source.quote: Nike has revealed the France 2026/27 Home kit, a deep blue design set to be worn by the France national football team at the 2026 FIFA World Cup
source.note: Kit maker, listed as partner per the convention for kit suppliers. FSC's launch description covers every mark on the shirt: 'The French Football Federation crest appears on the left chest in a metallic copper finish with two stars above, while the Nike Swoosh is placed on the right in a matching tone'; 'Inside the collar, a printed detail reads "Nos différences nous unissent", referencing unity within the national identity'; the full kit is completed with white shorts and red socks. The launch photos (worn and flat shirt, front, sleeves, collar detail) show no commercial sponsor on any placement.

summary: No sponsors on the shirt: Nike's deep blue 2026 home shirt (Game Royal base with a layered graphic pattern) carries only the French Football Federation crest in metallic copper and the Nike Swoosh; the launch description and photos show plain sleeves and white shorts (Football Shirt Culture's launch article and images).
